G1.statistic: M_K = GM T*(K=6) / GM T*(K=2) at alpha=1

G2.statistic: held-out RMSE reduction of M_K_exp over M_align_eff (log2 bits)
G2.threshold: >= 10%, lower bound > 0, lower on K=4, 0 invalid

G4.statistic: E = e_alpha / e_K (law-based, M_K_both on all points)
G4.threshold: E > 1 with lower bound > 1 in both units; E_mf > 1

G5.statistic: rho = g(65536) / g(4096), gap in bits (K=6 minus K=2) at alpha=1

G6.statistic: a1 in M_K_floor = M_K_exp + a1 (1 - alpha); held-out gain over M_K_exp
G6.threshold: a1 lower bound > 0 and gain >= 10% with lower bound > 0

G7.threshold: <= -0.5 with seed upper bound < 0, and < 0 over the 10 non-affine

G8b.statistic: Spearman(bdm_rowmajor_j, T*_j) at alpha=1, eps*=1.0, over 20 targets
